review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of the world-container import path over the installation (world-fvol-roles-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: (a) the runtime role of the `fvol*` volume records — over all 8 world containers, every unindexed record whose stored name carries the four-byte `fvol` prefix resolves to WorldCollisionRole::None under FOG_VOLUME_RECORD_NEVER_BLOCKS with its mesh kept as a known reference, because the decrypted image references that prefix exactly once (a strncmp(name, \"fvol\", 4) inside the routine that reads fogvol.zrd's fog keys) and no .zrd member anywhere in the installation spells it; the records that store geometry and carry no measured prefix keep UNINDEXED_ROLE_UNMEASURED, and the `fvol*` records the partition grid also names keep the index rule while the disagreement is counted by partition_records_fog_volume. (b) the world axis convention — the import reports the axis map it applied and its evidence class: identity, right-handed, radians, at observed_tool for an installation-backed source, contradicted when such a source applied another map, unknown for a designed source; the measurement is task #436's static analysis of the owner's decrypted image (sha256 43540fc97347210d6f4c10b77edbd4cdab1f03d57554d638223c2430a6c37d75), never a run. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in docs/findings/2026-10-07-m01-lc-fvol-roles-and-axis-convention.md: (1) retail is file access and the executable never ran, so nothing here is verified_original and no behavior landmark exists until #358 supplies a run; (2) the fog-volume resolution is a designed rule over a measured consumer — it says what this conversion presents, not that the 2000 engine never intersected a fog box; (3) how the original engine collided with a record its own spatial index names is still unmeasured, which is why the six grid-named `fvol*` records keep the index rule; (4) whether the fog system's own inside test is a render-only matter or reaches gameplay is not measured here. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item above is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every container imported and every unindexed record classified by a measured rule. The 4 assertions discovered under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
